description: Trigger eval for /rite-vet — the engineering review of a defined plan before build (scope challenge + architecture/code-quality/test-coverage/performance lenses). Must fire on plan-review intent; must NOT fire for the spec's strategy (rite-temper), one mid-build decision (devrites-doubt), a code diff (rite-review), the final gate (rite-seal), or initial planning (rite-define).

queries.text: /rite-vet
queries.rationale: Direct slash-command invocation.

queries.text: /rite vet
queries.rationale: Menu form of the same skill.

queries.text: vet the plan before we build
queries.rationale: Canonical trigger phrase from the description.

queries.text: do an engineering review of this plan
queries.rationale: Engineering-review intent on a plan.

queries.text: review the architecture in the plan before I start coding
queries.rationale: Architecture review of the plan, pre-build.

queries.text: lock in the implementation plan
queries.rationale: Lock-in-the-plan trigger.

queries.text: is this plan over-engineered, can we reuse instead of rebuild?
queries.rationale: Scope challenge / reuse-vs-rebuild is rite-vet's §0.

queries.text: check the test coverage design of the plan before building
queries.rationale: Test-coverage-design axis, pre-build.

queries.text: any performance or failure-mode risks in this plan?
queries.rationale: Performance + failure-mode axes of the plan review.

queries.text: we have plan.md and tasks.md — sanity-check the engineering before /rite-build
queries.rationale: Plan exists; engineering check before build is exactly rite-vet.

queries.text: get a different-model second opinion on the plan
queries.rationale: rite-vet --cross-model adds a different-model pass.

queries.text: the plan is defined, what's the right way to build it?
queries.rationale: "Right way to build it" is vet's job (vs temper's "right thing").

queries.text: is this the right, ambitious-enough thing to build?
queries.rationale: Strategy/ambition on the spec is /rite-temper, not vet.

queries.text: are we sure this one auth decision in the slice is safe?
queries.rationale: One mid-build decision is devrites-doubt, not a plan review.

queries.text: review my diff before I seal
queries.rationale: Reviewing written code is /rite-review, not the plan.

queries.text: GO or NO-GO — is it safe to ship?
queries.rationale: Final gate is /rite-seal.

queries.text: break the approved spec into task slices
queries.rationale: Initial planning is /rite-define; vet runs after.

queries.text: spec this new feature out
queries.rationale: Spec authoring is /rite-spec.

queries.text: what's the weather in Riga today?
queries.rationale: Unrelated; no DevRites skill should fire.
queries.owner_rationale: Unrelated; no DevRites skill should fire.

queries.text: rename this variable across the file
queries.rationale: A trivial edit, not a plan review.
queries.owner_rationale: A trivial edit, not a plan review.
